title: Bol.com Product Scraper
description: Scrape products from bol.com search result pages: title, price, rating, brand, seller and image. Paste one or more bol.com search URLs, or type a keyword.

urls.title: Search URLs
urls.description: Bol.com search result URLs, for example https://www.bol.com/nl/nl/s/?searchtext=waterkoker. Filters and sort order in the URL are kept. Product pages are not supported.

keyword.title: Keyword (replaces the URLs above)
keyword.description: Search term used instead of the URL list, for example waterkoker. Leave empty to use the URLs above.

maxResults.title: Maximum products
maxResults.description: Stop after this many products. Default 20.

maxPages.title: Maximum result pages
maxPages.description: Safety cap on result pages per search. Bol.com currently returns at most 10 pages for a search. Default 5.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Choose to use no proxy, Apify Proxy, or your own proxy URLs.
